plan.title: Herdr Agent Operations — persistent AQ-OS terminal presentation
plan.goal: A persistent, role-aware terminal workspace that makes AQ-OS work visible without becoming a second task, dispatch, review, or release authority.
success_criteria: Pinned and reproducible Herdr package with all update, manifest, plugin, restore and remote behaviors default-OFF
One deterministic aq-os workspace presents every managed role and exposes dark, orphaned, unmanaged and drifted state
Agent workers cannot reach the mutation-capable Herdr socket or binary
Phase-0, terminal Agent Ops and the web command center share one closed Herdr health projection
Detach, reattach, restart reconstruction and rollback preserve canonical AQ state and evidence

phases.name: H0 — capability intake
phases.goal: deny-by-default threat model and authority boundary

phases.name: H1 — inert packaging
phases.goal: reproducible package and read-only operator facade with no runtime

phases.name: H2 — monitored presentation
phases.goal: deterministic layout projection and Service Coverage

phases.name: H3 — brokered panes
phases.goal: admitted tasks execute in socket-blind confined Herdr PTYs

phases.name: H4 — dogfood and cutover
phases.goal: soak, remote attach, reconstruction and cmux terminology retirement
